liebermann.description_de: Phillipps 8078, dann H. S. Nichols & Co. zu London
liebermann.shelfmark_as_given: Phillipps MS 8078 (in 1903 owned by H. S. Nichols & Co., London)
liebermann.laws: ECf, Lib Lond, In Cn, Wl art
liebermann.notes: Written c. 1300, at Phillipps's until 1895, then owned by H. S. Nichols & Co., London. In the starred pieces it agrees with S but sometimes reads better, so it derives from sp: ECf, Libertas Londoniensis, Instituta Cnuti, Huntingdon's 'Chnutus rex cum XX annis', the Tripartita (Wl art, Genealogia Normannica to John), De longitudine Anglie, Glanvill and other pieces. Per f. 25 the exemplar of Pl and S followed the Ip Hunt class for In Cn and Tripartita.

entries.text_de:
Bis 1895 bei Phillipps 8078, dann H. S. Nichols & Co. zu London11 gehörig, um 1300 geschrieben, deckt sich in den hier besternten Stücken mit S, lautet aber bisweilen besser, entstammt also sp.

F. 1 *ECf, u. S. 627; f. 10 *Lib Lond, u. S. 673.

F. 11 *In Cn, u. S. 612; f. 25 *[Henr. Huntingdon.:] Chnutus rex cum XX annis; f. 26 Tripartita: *Wl art, u. S. 486; f. 27 *Geneal. Normannica bis Johann.

F. 31 *De longitudine et latitudine Anglie, et quod in ea 32 comitatus et II archiepiscopatus . . . Dann *Glanvilla, Brevia, Chartae, *Statuta, Placita, Assisa um Mitte 13. Jhs. Laut f. 25 folgt die Vorlage von PlS für In Cn und Tripartita Ip Hunt.
entries.text_en:
Until 1895 with Phillipps 8078, then belonging to H. S. Nichols & Co. in London11, written c. 1300, agrees in the pieces here starred with S, but sometimes reads better, and therefore derives from sp.

F. 1 *ECf, below, p. 627; f. 10 *Lib Lond, below, p. 673.

F. 11 *In Cn, below, p. 612; f. 25 *[Henr. Huntingdon.:] Chnutus rex cum XX annis; f. 26 Tripartita: *Wl art, below, p. 486; f. 27 *Geneal. Normannica to John.

F. 31 *De longitudine et latitudine Anglie, et quod in ea 32 comitatus et II archiepiscopatus . . . Then *Glanvilla, Brevia, Chartae, *Statuta, Placita, Assisa, about the middle of the 13th century. According to f. 25, the exemplar of PlS for In Cn and Tripartita follows Ip Hunt.

notes.text_de: vgl. mein Über Leges Ed. Conf. S. 126 ff.
notes.text_en: cf. my Über Leges Ed. Conf. p. 126 ff.

transcription.doubts: '*Geneal.' is printed with a damaged n ('Geɥeal.'); transcribed Geneal. Asterisks may be bold with the following siglum; I kept them outside <b>. The final 'In Cn und Tripartita Ip Hunt' is in roman, not bold or italic. Footnote 11 is the same note as for Pe.

others.text: O’Brien (2003): with College of Arms Vincent 98 and BL Harley 785 descends from a lost manuscript (his π), itself a sister of S.
